common: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: a THREE-FRAME horizontal game walk strip, one row, exactly THREE equally spaced full-body copies of ONE character. Plain exact #FF00FF background, no labels, no ground, no shadows. Preserve the identity, clothing, hair, colours, build and pixel-art treatment of attached identity master. Style standard is Batch 1 Light; named baseline montage contains middle frames of walk_jax_down, walk_karl_down, walk_kyle_down, walk_raelee_down, walk_rod_down. Clean pixel clusters, bold outlines, readable sprite faces, no painterly details. Entire bodies and all feet visible with space around each, same head top and foot baseline in every cell. Uniform frame dimensions. Aim landscape 1536x832, three512x832cells. All figures same scale: approximately740px tall inside cells.

prompts.down: All THREE figures face straight toward the viewer, front view. Column1 STRIDE A: screen-left shoe planted low, screen-right shoe raised visibly higher toward knee; opposite arms swing, screen-left hand raised at chest and screen-right hand down. Column2 NEUTRAL STANDING: both shoes together on same baseline, arms hanging. Column3 STRIDE B: screen-right shoe planted low, screen-left shoe raised higher; screen-right hand raised and screen-left hand down. Feet point at viewer throughout, toe fronts visible, NEVER profile-shaped shoes or sideways legs. Shoulder/sleeve/forearm/hand remain continuous.
prompts.up: All THREE figures face straight AWAY from viewer, backs of heads and clothing, no faces. Match FRONT strip's figure size EXACTLY: same hair-top, shoulder width, body height and foot baseline. Do not make back figures smaller. Column1 STRIDE A: screen-left heel planted low, screen-right heel lifted noticeably higher; left arm forward away from viewer, right arm back visible beside hip. Column2 NEUTRAL: both heels level, arms down. Column3 STRIDE B: screen-right heel planted low, screen-left heel lifted high; right arm away, left arm back. Shoes show backs of heels, NEVER profile silhouettes. Aprons show only neck loop and waist ties on the back, not a front bib printed on the back. Arms are one continuous shoulder/sleeve/forearm/hand shape.
prompts.left: All THREE figures face LEFT in strict side profile: noses, toes, chest face image LEFT in every column. Column1 STRIDE A: NEAR leg is distinctly LIGHT GREY and extends FORWARD to LEFT, far leg DARK GREY extends BACK to RIGHT. Near arm swings BACK to RIGHT with visible hand low behind hip; far hand raised forward LEFT. Column2 NEUTRAL: feet together below hip, arms down. Column3 STRIDE B: SAME NEAR leg stays LIGHT GREY but extends BACK to RIGHT; SAME FAR leg stays DARK GREY but extends FORWARD to LEFT. Near arm now raised FORWARD LEFT at chest, far hand behind RIGHT. Near/light and far/dark are permanent limb identities, never change tone based on whether forward. Both contacts must swap WHICH LEG crosses in front at the hip, and show clearly DIFFERENT arm silhouettes. Do not duplicate either stride. Temp greys only on trousers; preserve original outfit above legs and original shoe colours. For skirts keep skirt and bare calves: use lighter near calf/darker far calf instead of trousers. Maintain joined arms. Identical scale, head top and baseline in every cell.

method: built-in image_gen; right mirrored per frame, never generated
